D2_D4_D5_bank_and_shared_realizations.result: HELD (P2, P4). `Operation::ExpertProject { experts, top_k }` replaces `Project(FfnProjection)` for every per-expert matrix — multiplicity preserved (19,968 planned operands on the real container), the bank named on each. `RealizationForm::MappedStored { format }` with reason `BankMappedAsStored` is the bank's realization on the CPU: the stored bytes bound as regions of the object's ONE mapping (`OperandStore::map_region`, `PhysicalStore::map_segment` once per object, `LoadedWeight::Mapped`), executed in place through the production projection kernels the dense path already runs (bf16 fused matvec, f32 BLAS) — no new kernel. A stored form the CPU cannot run in place (Q8_0, BF16_ZLIB) is refused as `MissingRealization` with the reason spelled; the device backend refuses the host mapping by name. The shared expert's three projections are ordinary dense projections to the selector (size policy) and to the loader (`DenseOperands`), summed unscaled by the executor once for every backend; a gated branch (Qwen MoE's form) is planned as `SharedExpertBranchGate` and refused before any byte. The routed-FFN call carries its experts as `ExpertSlices::{Fused, Separate}` — the shape the bank stores — with the fused gate/up layout on the fused operand where it belongs.

D2_D4_D5_bank_and_shared_realizations.finding_V1-N3: The prepared plan's ACCOUNTING guessed each bound object's operation from the plan's FFN variant and the object count (`LayerFfn::Routed → ExpertBankSlice`), so the first reconciliation over a per-expert bank refused every expert (`pinned mapped-stored but nothing is resident for it`) and every shared projection: the observations were filed under the wrong operation. The loader now names the operation it bound each object for (`FfnOperands::bound` returns `(Operation, Bound)` pairs) and the accounting never infers it. The reconciliation caught its own assumption — the four-way correspondence is doing the job it was built for.
D2_D4_D5_bank_and_shared_realizations.finding_V1-N4: The routed call required a fused gate/up layout even for a bank that has no fused operand, so the first execution over a per-expert bank refused (`carries no gate_up layout`). The layout is a property of the FUSED operand and now travels on `ExpertSlices::Fused`; a per-expert bank carries none and needs none.
D2_D4_D5_bank_and_shared_realizations.finding_V1-N5: KDA and MLA layers are PREPARED (bound) by the prepared plan but not EXECUTED by it — the recurrent and latent operators run only through the Kimi-specific stack (`exec/stack.rs`, `exec/kda.rs`, `exec/mla.rs`). So the real Kimi-Linear container now selects, pins, prices and (with `--bind`) binds and reconciles through the prepared plan within budget, but cannot produce a token through it until those two operators are bound as realizations the same way the bank was. That is V3's first prerequisite, which the forecast's D7 did not name; the bytes-backed miniature uses softmax attention so that V1's execution proof does not wait for it.
